event_chain.summary: Former engineer exploits authentication bug from retained laptop
Current employees copy confidential materials for OpenAI

summary: In a July 10, 2026 lawsuit against OpenAI, its io Products unit and two former employees, Apple alleges that senior system electrical engineer Chang Liu, who left for OpenAI in January 2026, kept his Apple-issued laptop and from February 9 exploited an authentication bug to keep accessing Apple's confidential network storage, downloading dozens of files on unreleased products, engineering presentations and circuit board specifications, and coached a colleague still at Apple on copying materials without alerting security. Apple also alleges former VP Tang Tan had current Apple employees bring proprietary parts and designs to OpenAI interviews; it says at least 11 current and former employees were involved.
